findings.text: Biggest gain: T11, +0.40 s for HAM L43 over LEC L43. Brakes 50 m earlier, carries 14 km/h more minimum speed, gets on the throttle 7 m earlier.
Gain #2: T12, +0.28 s for HAM L43 over LEC L43. Brakes 12 m later, carries 12 km/h more minimum speed, exits 11 km/h faster.
Gain #3: T8-T9 straight, +0.24 s for HAM L43 over LEC L43. Reaches 17 km/h higher top speed.
Gain #4: T1, +0.22 s for LEC L43 over HAM L43. Brakes 12 m earlier, carries 10 km/h more minimum speed.
Gain #5: T9, +0.21 s for HAM L43 over LEC L43. Brakes 20 m later, carries 10 km/h more minimum speed, exits 14 km/h faster.
